pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Polygonal dark brown regions with rounded vertices. Edges exhibit moderate pixel gradients. Patches on the flank are larger and more elongated than those appearing towards the dorsal and posterior regions.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Cream-colored interstitial pathways form a continuous topological web. Junction nodes consistently link 3-4 corridors. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank with slight broadening at junction nodes.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane presents as a continuous, low-amplitude fuzzy silhouette against the background, with high-frequency micro-irregularities corresponding to hair tufts.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a small avian organism, likely an oxpecker, perched on the dorsal ridge at the junction of the neck and shoulder.
